title: OL-PR-2045: land or supersede pull request #2045 (ci-failed)
body:

**Trigger:** lane pass: pull request #2045 is ci-failed
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 2045
**Status:** closed

SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1: the server owns pull request #2045 (`dependabot/github_actions/actions-6212fb2f78` at ed48871a31, opened by app/dependabot): Bump the actions group with 2 updates. The session that opened it is not its closer and is never asked to act. A check failed on the head commit. Read the failing run, then land the same change so that every check passes: push a fix to the branch, or open a new pull request from main that carries the change and close this one as superseded. **Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
